correctness.rationale: Gauge the last q-class coordinate to zero. Cross-block inequalities force each v_j into [M−1,m+1], where m,M are u-block extrema. With z=(M−m)/2, h=1−z, center c=(m+M)/2, the root-coordinate Jacobian is constant; integration yields z~Beta(p−1,q+1) and c|z uniform [-h,h]. Thus Ez²=p(p−1)/(n(n+1)), Eh²=(q+1)(q+2)/(n(n+1)). Exchangeability fixes covariance scalar on two within-block contrast spaces and one between-block line; pairwise distance variances give λP and λQ, and centered difference of block means gives λB. Symbolically recomputed λB=(pq+2)/(3n(n+1)), λQ−λB=q(q−p+3)/(3n(n+1)), λB−λP=p(q−p−3)/(3n(n+1)) for all symbolic positive p,q; establishes transition, tie and κ formula. Root-gauge/intrinsic measure differ by constant Jacobian only. Source script triangulates six low-dimensional polytopes using exact rational simplex moments after floating vertex identification; inspected but did not treat it as unrestricted proof. No extrapolation from numerical cases.
